capabilities: Save Wisdio browser video notes as Markdown files in a chosen vault folder
Sync note content and filenames between Wisdio and Obsidian with revision checks
Copy images pasted into Wisdio into Obsidian's configured attachment location
Import existing Obsidian notes into Wisdio
Customize the Markdown template used for new Wisdio notes
extras: Desktop Obsidian 1.5.7+ only; runs a local loopback API/WebSocket server (default port 27125) secured by a generated API key; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Taking timestamped notes while watching videos usually means leaving the browser or manually copying notes into Obsidian afterward.

relations.evidence: Wisdio Companion is the Obsidian plugin that connects that browser workflow to your local vault.

summary: Syncs notes taken in the Wisdio browser video-note extension into your vault as Markdown files, with timestamps and image attachments.
